newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 1st-half GNP growth hits 7.06 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 1st-half GNP growth hits 7.06 pct.

text.p: Philippine gross national product growth in the first half of 1996 hit 7.06 percent against 5.6 percent in the same period last year, the National Economic Development Authority said on Saturday.
GNP growth in the second quarter of 1996 hit 7.69 percent against 4.9 percent in the same 1995 period, officials of the government agency told a news conference.
Gross domestic product growth in the first half of 1996 was 5.05 percent against 4.7 percent in the same 1995 period.
Second quarter 1996 GDP growth was 5.8 percent against 4.8 percent in the same 1995 period, the agency said.
